en.t: Miss, I will need to take a little more of your time.

units.source_text: 尽量让它连续休息一两个小时为好。

en.t: It would be best to let it rest continuously for an hour or two if possible.

units.source_text: 即使路途遥远，最好也让它走着回去为佳。

en.t: Even if the road is long, it would be better to let it walk back.

units.source_text: 坐车的话，汽车摇晃得厉害，

en.t: If it rides in a vehicle, the automobile will shake badly,

units.source_text: 还是乘坐相对平缓些的人力车为宜。”

en.t: so it would be better to take a relatively smoother rickshaw instead.”
